proposal.description: hiccup_done is cleared on the next entry into S_HICCUP (first active clock with the counter re-armed) instead of on leaving S_HICCUP
proposal.reason: After a finished cool-down, hiccup_done stays high once hiccup_active falls, through S_SS and S_RUN. On the next entry it is still high on the first active clock, so the supervisor leaves S_HICCUP at once and the escalated cool-down is skipped.

proposal.description: On leaving S_HICCUP, hiccup_done is cleared only once the counter has already been re-armed to zero, so the flag is dropped one clock after the counter instead of together with it
proposal.reason: When the supervisor leaves S_HICCUP after a finished cool-down, the counter is at its nonzero target. hiccup_done therefore stays high for one clock while hiccup_active is low, instead of falling on the first clock outside the state.
